status: pre-registered before observing any closed-loop training result
hypothesis: direct differentiable self-rollout supervision reduces exposure bias more effectively than iid input noise or inference-only alternating refinement
evidence_boundary: MISATO-100 12D invariant-feature mechanism proxy; not atomic Geo/Phys/Dyn/Stab and not an official score

training.checkpoint_policy: final epoch; no validation epoch selection
training.prefix_length_sampling: one integer uniformly sampled from [10, 90] for each batch update

comparison: paired corrected-T1 no-noise Transformer with identical architecture, budget, seeds and final-epoch policy

promotion.primary: mean equal-macro T1/T2/T3 RMSE below paired one-step reference
promotion.seed_consistency: beat paired reference in at least 2 of 3 seeds
promotion.T1_guard: mean T1 RMSE must not worsen by more than 2 percent
promotion.T3_mechanism: mean T3 RMSE must improve by at least 5 percent

no_posthoc_tuning: failure freezes horizon=10 and weight=0.25 as a no-go; no immediate weight or horizon sweep
